title: privacyassay-summary/1.0
description: On-device browser-fingerprint benchmark result. Two producers write this schema id: the CLI runner bin/privacyassay.mjs, and the in-page Save-summary button. They agree on schema, score, grade, verdict, randomizer, crossSite and note, but each adds its own fields, and the in-page file uses friendlier names for three of them: cappedBy is the CLI's strongest, topLeaks is its exposedStrong, and counts.readingsHidden/readingsTotal are its shownCount/readingsTotal. Both sets are described below, so read defensively rather than assuming the CLI vocabulary. Nothing in this document leaves the machine unless a human chooses to share it.

version.description: PRIORS catalog version the score was computed against

score.description: Share of the scored surfaces the browser hides. Higher is more private.

randomizer.description: True if the browser randomizes per site; then the single-site score is exposure on one page, not a grade

crossSite.description: Two-origin cross-site result. The CLI serves a single origin and emits null here; the in-page two-origin test populates it.

runs.description: Number of runs when --runs N>1; the reported score is the median

generated.description: In-page only: ISO 8601 timestamp of the run

browser.description: In-page only: the browser and add-ons the tool identified, or 'not identified'

cappedBy.description: In-page only: the heaviest reading still shown. Same value the CLI calls 'strongest'

topLeaks.description: In-page only: strong readings still shown. Same value the CLI calls 'exposedStrong'

handedOver.description: In-page only: every shown surface, heaviest first

counts.description: In-page only: reading tallies. readingsHidden and readingsTotal are the CLI's shownCount and readingsTotal
